questions.knowledge_point: Calculating the Area of the Parallelogram Spanned by Two Non-Parallel Vectors
questions.problem: Calculate the area of the parallelogram spanned by $\text{u}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 4\end{aligned}]$ and $\text{v}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3\end{aligned}].$
questions.worked_solution:
First, we construct a matrix where the columns are made up of the components of the corresponding vectors:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 4 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 4 & 3\end{aligned}| \\  & =3\cdot 3-2\cdot 4 \\  & =1\end{aligned}
$$

The absolute value of $det(M)$ gives the area $A$ of the parallelogram:

$$
A=|\,1\,|=1
$$

questions.problem: Calculate the area of the parallelogram spanned by $\text{u}=⟨4,1⟩$ and $\text{v}=⟨-6,-\frac{3}{2}⟩.$
questions.worked_solution:
First, we construct a matrix where the columns are made up of the components of the corresponding vectors:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}4 & -6 \\ 1 & -\frac{3}{2}\end{aligned}]
$$

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}4 & -6 \\ 1 & -\frac{3}{2}\end{aligned}| \\  & =4\cdot (-\frac{3}{2})-(-6)\cdot 1 \\  & =-6+6 \\  & =0\end{aligned}
$$

The absolute value of $det(M)$ gives the area $A$ of the parallelogram:

$$
A=|\,0\,|=0
$$

questions.problem: Calculate the area of the parallelogram spanned by $\text{u}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]$ and $\text{v}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 2\end{aligned}].$
questions.worked_solution:
First, we construct a matrix where the columns are made up of the components of the corresponding vectors:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =(-1)\cdot 2-2\cdot (-1) \\  & =-2+2 \\  & =0\end{aligned}
$$

The absolute value of $det(M)$ gives the area $A$ of the parallelogram:

$$
A=|\,0\,|=0
$$

questions.problem:
Determine the area $A$ of the parallelogram spanned by $\text{u}=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 3\end{aligned}]$ and $\text{v}=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 4\end{aligned}].$

$\,\,A=$ {{field-1}}
questions.worked_solution:
First, we construct a matrix where the columns are made up of the components of the corresponding vectors:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 5 \\ 3 & 4\end{aligned}]
$$

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}-2 & 5 \\ 3 & 4\end{aligned}| \\  & =(-2)\cdot 4-5\cdot 3 \\  & =-8-15 \\  & =-23\end{aligned}
$$

The absolute value of $det(M)$ gives the area $A$ of the parallelogram:

$$
A=|\,-23\,|=23
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Calculating the Area of the Parallelogram Spanned by Two Parallel Vectors
questions.worked_solution:
First, we construct a matrix where the columns are made up of the components of the corresponding vectors:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}7 & a \\ \frac{5}{2} & 5\end{aligned}]
$$

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}7 & a \\ \frac{5}{2} & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =7\cdot 5-a\cdot \frac{5}{2} \\  & =35-\frac{5a}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, setting the expression for the determinant equal to $0$ and solving for $a,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}35-\frac{5a}{2} & =0 \\ \frac{5a}{2} & =35 \\ 5a & =70 \\ a & =14.\end{aligned}
$$
